pier_manager.text: Welcome aboard. Technically you are standing on a pier, which is a seaside street that gave up on land.
Aberystwyth's Royal Pier opened in 1865, designed by Eugenius Birch. He built piers all round Britain, so he knew a good plank.
The sea has taken bites out of it over the years. The Pavilion at the end gets a fresh coat of paint every time it sulks.

pier_harpist.text: A harp carries well over the waves. Not as far as a tuba, but the gulls like it even less.
The Welsh triple harp, telyn deires, has three rows of strings. Learning it takes about three times as long as the ordinary kind.
